title: DriveThruRPG Digital Reward Delivery Now Available in BackerKit Pledge Manager
summary: DriveThruRPG digital reward delivery is now in BackerKit Pledge Manager. Automate TTRPG digital download delivery to backers' DriveThruRPG libraries after your campaign ends.
body_markdown:
In June, we launched our[DriveThruRPG integration](https://www.backerkit.com/blog/backerkit-drivethrurpg-integration?ref=blog.backerkit.com) to power Instant Access Rewards on[BackerKit](https://www.backerkit.com/?ref=blog.backerkit.com) , allowing creators to automatically deliver digital rewards to backers the moment they pledge, reserve, or follow a campaign *before* it ends.


Today, we're bringing that same capability to[BackerKit Pledge Manager](https://www.backerkit.com/pledge-manager?ref=blog.backerkit.com) .


Now,[Tabletop RPG (TTRPG)](https://www.backerkit.com/tabletop-role-playing-games?ref=blog.backerkit.com) creators who choose to fulfill their rewards through BackerKit Pledge Manager can seamlessly send their digital rewards directly into backers' DriveThruRPG libraries *after* the campaign ends.


**For backers,** this means digital rewards land directly in their DriveThruRPG library. Their next adventure, right where they keep all the others.


**For creators,** this means no more manual fulfillment for post-campaign digital downloads. Connect your DriveThruRPG account once, then automate digital reward distribution for every campaign.


By expanding our DriveThruRPG integration into post-campaign fulfillment, the[BackerKit Crowdfunding Platform](https://www.backerkit.com/for-creators?ref=blog.backerkit.com) now supports streamlined DriveThruRPG digital reward delivery across the entire campaign lifecycle - from pre-launch, live, to post-campaign fulfillment. It's an end-to-end DriveThruRPG integration you'll only find on BackerKit.


Streamlined DriveThruRPG Digital Reward Delivery Through BackerKit Pledge Manager


Manual fulfillment of digital rewards can lead to costly mistakes. From a mistyped email to a broken link, each error means a delayed reward and a support ticket from a disappointed backer.


BackerKit's DriveThruRPG integration removes those steps entirely, granting the correct titles to every qualifying backer and notifying them of their available reward without leaving BackerKit Pledge Manager.


**Key Benefits**


- **Automate post-campaign digital reward delivery** in just a few clicks
- **Avoid manual errors** that can impact backer experience and your brand reputation
- **Deliver titles to backers’ DriveThruRPG libraries** , no file links to lose
- **Connect once** and use across every future campaign
- **Push file updates to every backer’s library** , no re-uploading or resending


> *"On our Designers & Dragons: Origins campaign, we had nine different digital rewards to offer and a customer base enthusiastic about getting access to those rewards on their DriveThruRPG virtual bookshelf. Backerkit's integration with DriveThru meant our backers gained instant access to all of their rewards without having to redeem each item separately, **saving everyone time and keeping our backers happy with us and confident about our project.** " - Fred Hicks, Co-founder,*[Evil Hat Productions](https://www.backerkit.com/c/users/15053?ref=blog.backerkit.com) *· Multi-award-winning creator · 33 campaigns*


[Learn more about our DriveThruRPG partnership integration](https://www.backerkit.com/partners/drivethrurpg?ref=blog.backerkit.com) .


**RELATED: \[Webinar\] BackerKit, DriveThruRPG, & Evil Hat - Nov. 5 📆** Sign up here →[TTRPG Crowdfunding: How the game has changed, and where it's headed next](https://www.crowdcast.io/c/evilhat-drivethrurpg?ref=blog.backerkit.com)


## How It Works


For **backers** , the experience is familiar and frictionless:


1. Once you start distribution and send notifications, backers receive a BackerKit notification email
2. The email takes them to their BackerKit rewards page, where their DriveThruRPG reward is marked as sent to their library, along with any instructions you've added
3. One click on G *o to my DriveThruRPG library* , then a quick login to DriveThruRPG, and they're ready to play


Backers without a free DriveThruRPG account will be prompted to create one to access their library.


## Getting Started


For **creators and publishers** , you'll need the following to use the integration:


- A DriveThruRPG publisher account.[Create your free account today >>](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/?ref=blog.backerkit.com)
- An active BackerKit Pledge Manager project.[Get started with BackerKit Pledge Manager >>](https://www.backerkit.com/pledge-manager?ref=blog.backerkit.com)
- Your DriveThruRPG Application Key, found in your DriveThruRPG account settings. Make sure "Distribution" is toggled on.


[See the full setup guide](https://blog.backerkit.com/content/files/2026/11/973-how-do-i-integrate-with-drivethrurpg-in-pledge-manager.html) .


**Have yet to launch a project on BackerKit?**[Get a demo of the BackerKit Platform today](https://form.typeform.com/to/B7alFvbe?ref=blog.backerkit.com) .
